summary: Frontend + integration regression run on public preview completed with QA1/QA2. Core Practice typography, Voiceroom notices title/read-only behavior, room create->route, room minimize/reopen, and send icon asset wiring (chat + room) were validated. Native Android/iOS evidence was verified from generated logs/artifacts only; real device/native build execution remains blocked by environment.

ui_bugs.issue: Header still renders 'Voice Rooms' instead of requested exact 'Voiceroom'.
Create button can be pushed outside viewport while keyboard is open; submit fails unless keyboard is dismissed/scroll adjusted.

integration_issues.issue: Call creation succeeds (POST /api/rtc/calls 201) but QA2 did not receive incoming popup (call-accept-btn never appeared) in browser 2-context test; flow blocked before connection verification.
Moments feed had zero cards for both QA1 and QA2 in this environment, so #voiceroom auto-share, detail comment send persistence, and translate button API path could not be exercised.

issues: Read-only screen intent appears correct (no chat composer controls exposed), but this run only hit empty state due no notices data.

react_native_issues.issue: Expo error log showed repeated ENOENT scandir '/app/frontend/sounds' during asset request handling; needs RCA to ensure no stale/wrong runtime sound path remains.

action_items: Update Voice tab title copy to exact requested label 'Voiceroom'.
Fix incoming-call delivery/visibility for callee context (WS/incoming event path) so call-accept popup reliably appears.
Ensure create-room CTA remains tappable with keyboard open on 390/320 widths (avoid off-screen submit).
Seed or restore QA-safe Moments fixture so #voiceroom share/tag + comment/translate regressions can be validated end-to-end.
Investigate Metro '/app/frontend/sounds' ENOENT runtime requests and remove stale path resolution.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/app/room/[id].tsx is ~3505 lines (>700 guideline), making room session regressions harder to isolate and test.
frontend/app/(tabs)/moments.tsx is ~1766 lines (>700 guideline), contributing to brittle selector/loading behavior and difficult targeted QA.
Large screen modules should be split into smaller focused units (composer, notices, actions, translation handlers, quota panels) for safer regression coverage.

success_rate.backend: N/A (per request, full backend suite not rerun)
success_rate.frontend: 70% (core UI regressions mostly pass; call receive + moments-dependent flows blocked/failing)

seed_data_creation: Created temporary QA host rooms and posted limited QA messages/comments during verification; attempted cleanup by leaving created rooms only. No broad delete/ledger wipe actions performed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Practice typography checks passed (shortcut 11px, in-call title 18px, chats title 28px). Send icon file integrity verified (7099 bytes, sha256 28f7b1953f4ecc712c3acb86301ee5f375811393bdac5531b42000ce8d76784a) and runtime src resolved to /assets/?unstable_path=.%2Fassets%2Ficons/send.png in chat + room. Voiceroom notices title/preview string checks passed. Native matrix/artifacts reviewed; real Android/iOS compile/device/Bluetooth/background/cellular remained NOT RUN (environment blocked).
rca_of_issue: Two-user call RCA (web preview): caller-side call creation reached backend (201) but callee incoming popup did not surface in automation context, suggesting incoming-event delivery/consumption issue (likely WS lifecycle/race/presence state) rather than create API failure. For moments-related checks, missing feed fixtures prevented end-to-end validation rather than a deterministic client crash.
